findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_threat_indicators, get_cve_details, get_ioc_context, get_ioc_batch, check_wallet_sanctions, check_domain_age, check_hostname_reputation, check_ip_abuse · Private data: get_threat_indicators, get_ioc_context, check_wallet_sanctions, check_hostname_reputation, check_wallet_age, check_ip_abuse · Public sink: subscribe_alerts, submit_indicator, check_ip_abuse, check_package · Destructive: check_wallet_sanctions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_threat_indicators, get_cve_details, get_ioc_context, get_ioc_batch, check_wallet_sanctions, check_domain_age, check_hostname_reputation, check_ip_abuse · Private data: get_threat_indicators, get_ioc_context, check_wallet_sanctions, check_hostname_reputation, check_wallet_age, check_ip_abuse · Public sink: subscribe_alerts, submit_indicator, check_ip_abuse, check_package · Destructive: check_wallet_sanctions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
